shots.vo: What if nothing had started on February twenty-fourth, two thousand twenty-two? *A day in Moscow*.
You walk into McDonald's. A Big Mac, fries, a Coke — *same as always*.
You pay with your phone. Apple Pay and your Visa card work everywhere — *in Moscow and in Paris*.
Netflix in the evening. On the weekend — IKEA for a *new sofa* and Zara for a jacket.
One dollar is *seventy-five rubles*. The new iPhone is in the official store on launch day.
Summer in Europe. A multi-year Schengen visa, a direct flight, and *four hours later* you are in Paris.
Which of these would you miss *the most*?
